instrument: scripts/check_reconcile.sh v0.67.0 --prev-tag v0.66.0 --json  (PR #3200, unmerged at measurement time)
verdict: RED - R2, R3 and R4 nonzero; all three are findings about the PREDICATES, see findings[]

findings.claim: R2 cannot be zero over a window that predates its own guard, so T-5 as written hard-fails every train forever.
findings.evidence: check_pr_closes_issue.sh is not on main; it is in PR #3200, still in the merge queue at measurement time. Every one of the 35 PRs in v0.66.0..v0.67.0 merged before any such check existed.
findings.detail: The 35 cite 39 still-open issues, and inspection shows most citations are CORRECT behaviour: #3160 and #3175 FILED their follow-ups (#3147-#3159, #3170-#3174) and cite them without closing, which is what a backlog-opening PR should do. R2's remedy for that shape is the `no-close: <reason>` line, which those bodies could not carry because the guard did not exist.
findings.recommendation: R2 needs an EPOCH: count only PRs merged after the guard was armed on main. Without one the predicate measures history and can never reach zero.

findings.claim: R3's predicate cannot distinguish a DEAD branch from a STRANDED one, and acting on it literally destroys measurement evidence.
findings.evidence: Both branches R3 named carry unique unmerged work. feat/y2-calibrate holds evidence/perf-060/ (791 insertions) — the only measurement of mini's throughput that exists (prefill 2.371-2.372, decode 2.318 tok/s) — measured 2026-08-30 against 34248e8fe. feat/y1-7bgarbage holds a contract, an example and a script.
findings.action: feat/y2-calibrate landed as PR #3211 rather than deleted; R3 fell 2 -> 1. feat/y1-7bgarbage is NOT archived: it touches contracts/continuous-batching-v1.yaml and needs a review, not a publish.
findings.recommendation: R3 should report `no open PR AND no unique commits vs main` as dead, and `no open PR AND unique commits` as stranded — different verdicts, different remedies.

findings.claim: R4 is volatile against main, not a property of the PR: it read 0, then 1, within ten minutes.
findings.evidence: R4=0 at 11:44Z after this session resolved every dirty stale PR; R4=1 at 11:50Z naming #3041, because #3164, #3162 and #3201 merged as one queue group in between.
findings.detail: #3041 (agent/R-0b, 96 files) conflicts on 18 files and its L0-1 subset belongs to #3004, which is armed but unmerged. Re-merging before #3004 lands would have to be redone.
findings.recommendation: Measure R4 at a fixed sha, or accept that a squash-merge makes every stacked branch dirty and re-run after the queue drains.

unmeasured: attended_minutes [U] — this train's T-4 was automated; no attended window was timed
